name: Backup failed or stale
description: Backup success is 0, or backup age is over 25 hours, for 1 hour 15 minutes.
programText:
success = data('grokbot.backup.success')
age = data('grokbot.backup.age_hours')
detect(when(success == 0, lasting='1h15m') or when(age > 25, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Backup failed or stale')

rules.parameterizedBody: Backup failed or stale is {{status}} at {{timestamp}}.
